title: D'Almeida, Mossel Bay (open field, approx.): man found stabbed dead, 8 Oct
summary: Da Gamaskop police are investigating a murder after a man's body with stab wounds was found in bushes in an open field between D'Almeida and Albert Luthuli Park, near Mountain View, at about 10:50 on Thursday 8 October. ...
story: Da Gamaskop police are investigating a murder after a man's body with stab wounds was found in bushes in an open field between D'Almeida and Albert Luthuli Park, near Mountain View, at about 10:50 on Thursday 8 October. Three suspects aged 28 to 43 were later arrested and appeared in court on 13 October (Mossel Bay Advertiser).
incident: Body found Thu 8 Oct 2026, about 10:50 (police); time of death not given
location_note: Open field between D'Almeida and Albert Luthuli Park, near Mountain View, Mossel Bay. The field is not on the map, so the pin is the D'Almeida suburb point.
basis: Two reports from one outlet, both based on police statements.

provenance.statement_from: Police: the first report, then an arrest update
